entry.title: Galata Tower
entry.note: Circular exact-QID OSM footprint center supplies the anchor; museum brochure explicitly locates the entrance on the south axis. Native +Z is south, so heading 0. review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
